title: Annual conference of pathology
html:
Full conference program

The Annual Pathology Conference of the `Victor Babeș` Institute, Bucharest brings together researchers, clinicians, and industry representatives to advance biomedical science.Sessions highlight basic research, including 3D models for non-communicable diseases, novel animal models, and biomarker discovery, as well as pathology, with emphasis on kidney and gastrointestinal diseases, showcasing new diagnostic and therapeutic insights. A dedicated SME–Academia Networking Session will foster translational collaboration, linking small and medium enterprises with research institutions to accelerate innovation.

Conference abstracts will be indexed in BMC Proceedings, part of Springer-Nature (https://bmcproc.biomedcentral.com/).

Abstracts must be submitted in UK English, they must be original and must not have been previously published elsewhere. The accepted format is .DOC, .DOCX or .PDF. Abstract template.

The Conference is CME credited by the Romanian College of Physicians – 18 CMR credits.

The Conference also hosts an e-Poster session (template). – submission deadline 1 Nov 2025. 

Three workshops are available for PhD Students , MSc Students, Interns Doctors and Medical/Biology Students as follows:

  • Immunofluorescence on Renal Biopsy – November 13, 9.00-15.00, Victor Babes National Institute of Pathology (5 paid seats) 
  • Western Blot hands-on workshop (6 paid seats): Friday, November 14th, 10.00-14.00, Biochemistry Laboratory of Victor Babes National Institute of Pathology 
  • PCR hands-on workshop (6 paid seats): November 14th, 10.00-14.00, Cellular and Molecular Biology Laboratory of Victor Babes National Institute of Pathology 

Attendance fee per workshop: 150 RON.

Workshop participants are welcomed to attend the scientific sessions of the conference.

Registration is now open and can be accessed through one of the two options below.

Registration closed

Conference registration fee: 500 RON.

For abstract submission, the payment of the fee will be required after acceptance, in order to complete registration.

For ePoster session, following abstract acceptance and fee payment, the ePoster must be submitted as .pptx to ipc@ivb.ro.


Accepted payment types for this event are : GooglePay and Direct Card. For any inquiries please contact  the organizers at ipc@ivb.ro.
